interpretation.supported: The generic continuous-trait spatial layer transports unchanged to an external, non-flower municipal tree inventory and detects positive within-taxon geographic organization of log(DBH) under a matched vertex-permutation null.
not_supported: DBH variation amount predicts stronger spatial organization across taxa
the observed spatial organization is caused by ecology rather than planting, management, age structure or inventory processes
naive pooled and species-conditioned statistics estimate the same target
taxon labels in the municipal inventory are taxonomically validated species concepts
this single empirical dataset establishes universal external validity
